s0005 has only 慕藺相如之為人也; 趙 is absent, so English “of Zhao” invents polity not stated in this sentence, and dropping it restores the Chinese scope.
When they were deep in wine, the magistrate stepped forward with a zither and said, “I hear you are fond of this instrument—may I offer you a tune for your pleasure?”
When they were deep in wine, the magistrate stepped forward with a zither and said, “I have heard that Zhangqing is fond of this; I wish to amuse myself with it.”
The quoted speech is 竊聞長卿好之，願以自娛: the magistrate names Zhangqing and says he wishes to amuse himself; “offer you a tune for your pleasure” reverses agent and beneficiary.
